Hummingbird Cottage by Oversee | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Hummingbird Cottage in Sugarwood Beach offers a peaceful retreat at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac. With plenty of seating and a welcoming screened porch, it’s the perfect place to unwind and enjoy your surroundings. The bright and colorful living area is cozy, with a fireplace and an open flow to the dining room and gourmet kitchen. The primary suite features a king bed, a private bath, and its own porch for a relaxing spot to sip your morning coffee. A laundry-mud room leads to a peaceful backyard surrounded by woods. Upstairs, a charming nook with patriotic art sets the tone for the second-floor rooms.

The guest room has hummingbird décor, and the nautical-themed bunk room is perfect for the kids. Both rooms share a Jack-and-Jill bath with separate vanities. For extra privacy, the carriage house above the garage offers a queen bed, full kitchen, and space for two guests. Enjoy all the excitement 30A has to offer, then retreat to the tranquility of Hummingbird Cottage. At Oversee, we’re a small, locally-owned company dedicated to providing a clean, consistent experience. Our office is nearby, and we’re always just a call away to assist with anything you need during your stay.
